# Split Hero

`hero/split` &middot; section-level &middot; category: hero

## Purpose

An image beside the headline, description and button. Image left by default, text left with the reverse variant.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | text |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: IMAGE | TEXT. The image is first on mobile.
- **reverse**: TEXT | IMAGE. The image is still first on mobile. Sets `imagePosition: right`.
- **large-image**: IMAGE | TEXT with a 60/40 split. Sets `split: 60/40`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileLayout` | one of `stack`, `reverse` | `"stack"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `split` | text | `"50/50"` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"middle"` |
| `headingLevel` | one of `h1`, `display`, `h2` | `"h1"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileLayout`: `stack`, `reverse`. How columns arrange on phones (stack keeps order, reverse puts the last first, preserve keeps them side by side).
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts shows the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('hero/split', {
  "eyebrow": "The Terrace Edit",
  "headline": "Dressed for long lunches",
  "description": "Loose linens and soft neutrals, styled for afternoons that last until the light goes.",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the edit",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/terrace"
  },
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/560x560/png?text=Terrace",
    "alt": "A woman in a sand linen shirt at a terrace table"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "hero/split",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "The Terrace Edit",
    "headline": "Dressed for long lunches",
```
